dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, symmetrical narrowing from a wide anterior region toward a sharp, pointed posterior termination.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-to-moderate frequency of small, circular, light-colored spots scattered across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp contrast gradients between the light-colored spots and the dark grey skin.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, dark, high-contrast longitudinal linear mark located on the anterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A longitudinal shadow-casting groove along the central dorsal axis in the anterior section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent longitudinal scar or deep traumatic indentation on the anterior dorsal ridge.
